content.comment_body: Using a [product_name] HMI together with [product_name] [version_no], I've configured weekly timers. When selecting Monday or Tuesday on the HMI, the timer output is activated even when the LOGO software does not display them as active. For example, if today is Monday, selecting Tuesday will still trigger the timer. This does not happen for other days of the week. Does anyone have suggestions?
Hello [user_name], Could you share screenshots showing how the timers are set up in [product_name] [product_name]?
Please upload your engineering project file and [product_name] program as a ZIP archive.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is facing a problem where choosing Monday or Tuesday on the HMI results in the timer output being active on [product_name] [version_no], even though neither day appears as active in the configuration software. This only occurs for those two days, suggesting a mismatch in timer mapping or configuration between the HMI and [product_name].
analysis.user_expectations: The user wants timer activations on the HMI and [product_name] [version_no] to only occur for the selected days, expecting no overlap or unintended activation between days.
